$comment: Operating assumptions for the cost model. These are estimates, not measurements - Phase 0 benchmark replaces the latency/take numbers with measured ones.

nameClip.$seconds: Measured 2026-11-10 with Jerry B: only 'Hello, <name>!' is lip-synced (mid-pause to mid-pause); 'Ho ho ho' and the elves line stay master
nameClip.$takes: Average generations per library name including QA retakes

library.$names: EN = top 2,000 each from US SSA + UK ONS + Canada (ex-QC) after dedup; FR = Quebec (Retraite Quebec) + France (INSEE) after dedup

instant.$rare: Share of orders whose name is not in the library yet (each rare render then joins the library)

custom.$personalized: If the locked template keeps fixed sentences pre-rendered and only personalized sentences are lip-synced
custom.$previews: Audio previews generated per paid custom order (abandoners included)

$amortization: Total instant videos delivered (B2C + business, both languages) that the one-off library cost is spread over
